title: Tender demands ISI mark for IS 456 concrete
description: BOQ clause: 'All concrete shall be ISI marked as per IS 456:2000'. IS 456 is a code of practice; no product licence exists.
correct_action: Remove ISI-mark requirement; specify materials (cement, steel, aggregates) that do carry Scheme-I licences and require mix design + cube tests per IS 456.

title: Fe500 ordered in seismic zone III instead of Fe500D
description: Structural drawings specify Fe500; site is seismic zone III. IS 13920 requires enhanced ductility (Fe500D or higher).
correct_action: Amend to Fe500D / Fe500S as applicable; verify mill certificates show elongation ≥16%.

title: IT tender asks for ISI mark on laptops under IS 13252
description: Tender requires 'ISI Mark CM/L number as per IS 13252 Part 1'. Product is under CRS; correct marking is R-number.
correct_action: Change to 'BIS CRS Registration (R-number) under IS 13252 (Part 1):2010'.

title: Power-bank tender cites IS 16046 Part 1 for lithium cells
description: Specification lists IS 16046 (Part 1). Lithium systems are Part 2.
correct_action: Correct to IS 16046 (Part 2):2018; require separate R-number for lithium chemistry.

title: Helmet BOQ missing amendments to IS 4151:2015
description: Tender cites IS 4151:2015 without Amendment 1 (2018) or Amendment 2 (2020).
correct_action: Specify 'IS 4151:2015 with all amendments' and require current licence scope covering the amendments.

title: Gold jewellery tender demands Scheme-I ISI licence
description: Tender requires manufacturer to hold Scheme-I licence under IS 1417. Hallmarking is a different scheme.
correct_action: Require BIS-registered jeweller + hallmarking through recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centre per IS 1417 / IS 15820.

title: Appliance QCO cites outdated IS 302 (Part 1):2008 after transition
description: New contract after concurrent-running end date still references 2008 edition.
correct_action: Update to IS 302 (Part 1):2024 / IEC 60335-1:2020 and verify MSME category deadlines.

title: Structural steel specified as 'IS 2062 Fe410' without quality class
description: Old Fe-nomenclature used; no impact-test class (A/BR/B0/C) stated.
correct_action: Map Fe410 → E250 and add required quality class (e.g. E250 BR). Confirm current edition year.

title: Fire extinguisher tender mixes IS 2190 and IS 15683
description: Product compliance clause cites IS 2190 (code of practice) instead of IS 15683 (product standard).
correct_action: Product shall conform to IS 15683:2018; installation/maintenance per IS 2190:2010.

title: Drinking-water tank tender requires ISI mark under IS 10500
description: Tender treats IS 10500 as a product standard requiring ISI mark on the water or tank.
correct_action: IS 10500 is a water-quality specification. Specify tank material standard separately and require water test reports against IS 10500 limits.
